flag_warnings.max_model_len=180000: Chain governance mandates 180000; experiments validated only up to 131072. First production deployment under load is the proof point. Set high enough that cross-node PoC validation matches; lower will diverge on long-context prompts.
flag_warnings.max_num_seqs=128 (batch_size=64 hard cei: Phase 3 sweep observed batch_size=64 hangs the PoC engine (OOM-stuck, not crash — engine never recovers). max_num_seqs=128 from MINIMAX_M2_7 base is safe because vLLM runtime caps actual batch by KV cache; the hazard is operator-supplied PoC batch override. Same failure as flashinfer_moe_int4_blackwell.md memory entry.

flag_descriptions.max_model_len=180000: Chain governance mandates 180000; experiments validated only up to 131072. First production deployment under load is the proof point. Set high enough that cross-node PoC validation matches; lower will diverge on long-context prompts.
flag_descriptions.tensor_parallel_size=2: 2×B200 = 360 GB HBM, fits chain VRam=320 GB requirement with headroom for FP8 KV cache. Phase 3 batch sweep: 2→1364, 8→2256, 16→2560, 32→2624 (best), 64→hang. Vast.ai inst 41067, 2026-05.
flag_descriptions.max_num_seqs=128 (batch_size=64 hard cei: Phase 3 sweep observed batch_size=64 hangs the PoC engine (OOM-stuck, not crash — engine never recovers). max_num_seqs=128 from MINIMAX_M2_7 base is safe because vLLM runtime caps actual batch by KV cache; the hazard is operator-supplied PoC batch override. Same failure as flashinfer_moe_int4_blackwell.md memory entry.
flag_descriptions.post-sweep memory accumulation: After Phase 3 batch sweep the PyTorch caching allocator accumulates ~170 GB of unreleased buffers; subsequent 1000-nonce collection requires a vLLM restart to clear cache. Not a fatal issue under normal chain workload (no multi-batch sweep), but operators running benchmark + production back-to-back should restart between.
flag_descriptions.attention_backend=FLASHINFER (explicit): The 2624 nonces/min measurement was made with FLASHINFER attention. vLLM's auto-selector picks the same on Blackwell sm_100 today, but pinning explicitly defends against the heuristic changing across vLLM versions and silently regressing throughput on this profile.
